Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis. It incorrectly stated that "Common knowledge suggests Algeria's first Round of 16 appearance was at the 2014 FIFA World Cup" and subsequently concluded the answer was Brazil. In reality, Algeria qualified for the Round of 16 for the first time in the 2010 FIFA World Cup (hosted by South Africa), where they famously defeated the Netherlands and Germany. This hallucination in the very first step led to the wrong final conclusion, despite the WebSurfer tool providing correct search results.
